title: Independent verification: rounded Newton prefix cells and exact recovery (no new kappa)
body:
The retained Section 09 rounded Newton routines now have a bounded independent numerical replay. An integer-significand evaluator and a separately written exact-rational evaluator agree on every rounded operation for 65,280 normalized input cells. A written prefix-cell argument extends the endpoint checks to every real normalized input at target precisions 1 through 8.

The package also verifies 86,870 division tuples and 510 roots at supplied widths 1 through 8, plus 4,468 boundary divisions and 270 roots through 168 bits. It records exact margins, transcript digests, 16 rejection controls, source pins and seven semantic tests. This is a downstream corollary audit, with no new kappa, all-precision proof, fixed-tape realization or supplier-admission claim.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/newton-prefix-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_BOUNDED_NEWTON_PREFIX_AUDIT`, seven passing tests, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/newton-prefix-audit outcome=completed`.

Validation: registered Python 3.12.13 replay passed; a relocated read-only export passed under isolated optimized Python 3.14.6 with identical certificate content; a deleted certificate row was rejected. All five selected-result tests pass. Hosted CI is separate. Only `research/newton-prefix-audit/` is added.

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. Retained OpenAI source: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`. No pending PR is a dependency. The final overlap refresh covered 765 open PRs and 198 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; no matching Section 09 scope was found. The selected record and all upstream inputs are unchanged.

Credit OpenAI's manuscript and its cited Brent reductions, Douglas Colkitt's repository/audit guidance, and the related but distinct moment and Newton-kernel verification work recorded in the package. Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Separate implementations do not constitute independent human review. Apache-2.0.
